user.title: Add a location
user.description: Enter a name and choose a region. Then enter the exact station (transformer station) name as the notices write it, for example Zabukovica Papež.

data_description.name: The name of the location, for example Home.
data_description.region: The region feed to watch. Choose All regions if you are not sure.
data_description.station: Choose a name from the list, or type the exact station name as the notices write it, without TP. The match ignores case, accents and spacing only. A part of the name does not match. The list shows the station names that are in the feeds now.
data_description.notify_targets: The phones that get a notification about the outages of this location. All phones are selected. Clear the list to turn the notifications off.

reconfigure.title: Change the location
reconfigure.description: Change the name, the region or the station. If you change the region or the station, the stored alert history is cleared.

data_description.name: The name of the location, for example Home.
data_description.region: The region feed to watch. Choose All regions if you are not sure.
data_description.station: Choose a name from the list, or type the exact station name as the notices write it, without TP. The match ignores case, accents and spacing only. A part of the name does not match. The list shows the station names that are in the feeds now.

confirm.title: Check the location

abort.already_configured: This region and station are already set up.
abort.invalid_import: The imported location is not valid.
abort.unload_failed: The location could not be unloaded. Nothing was changed. Restart Home Assistant and try again.

data_description.notify_targets: The phones that get a notification about the outages of this location. Clear the list to turn the notifications off.
data_description.reminder_time: The time of day when the integration sends the reminder for an outage on the next day. The reminder ignores the quiet hours: it arrives at this time.
data_description.quiet_hours: At night the notifications wait. They arrive when the quiet hours end. A notification about an outage that starts before the end arrives at once. The events never wait.
data_description.quiet_from: The start of the quiet hours.
data_description.quiet_to: The end of the quiet hours. If the end is equal to the start, the quiet hours are off.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Use an entity instead of the quiet hours times.

data_description.quiet_entity: A schedule, a toggle helper or a binary sensor, for example a Schedule helper. If you choose one, it replaces the times: the notifications wait while its state is on. Quiet hours must be on.

no_planned_outage.message: No planned outage for this station now. This is normal.

deprecated_yaml.title: The Elektro Celje YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Home Assistant imported your Elektro Celje binary sensors from YAML into config entries. Remove the `elektro_celje` platform entries from your YAML files, then restart Home Assistant. The imported locations keep working. Entity IDs of the new entities can differ from the old entity IDs.
